entities.summary: Megan Keller is an American professional ice hockey player and captain for the Boston Fleet of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL). She is a member of the United States women's national ice hockey team, with whom she won gold medals at the 2018 and 2026 Winter Olympics. Keller scored the golden goal in the gold medal match of the 2026 tournament. She also won a silver medal at the 2022 Winter Olympics. Keller is a six-time World Champion, winning gold medals in 2015, 2016, 2017, 2019, 2023, and 2025.
